sections.content_text: Section 79 - Exemption of Certain Incomes of Co-operative Societies Income earned by a co-operative society from the following activities shall be exempted from tax payable, namely: (a) crop production; (b) management of cottage industries; (c) marketing of agricultural produce by its members. Explanation. —For the purpose of this section, “cottage industry” means an undertaking, not being registered by joint stock company, where— (a) the owner of the business establishment is an investor, full time employee and bona fide entrepreneur; (b) the capital invested in the plant, machinery and equipment of the business does not exceed Tk. 25 (twenty five) lakhs at any time during the income year; (c) the number of workers working in the business establishment including the owner and his family members is not more than 15 (fifteen) people.
